```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
names (penguins)
penguins = janitor::clean_names(penguins)
```

The 'penguins' dataset includes different measurments of penguins and their body parts.
It has 'r nrow(penguins)' rows and 'r ncol(penguins)' columns. 
The mean flipper length is 'r mean(pull(penguins, flipper_length_mm), na.rm = TRUE)'

```{r}
skimr::skim(penguins)
mean(pull(penguins, flipper_length_mm), na.rm = TRUE)
```
```{r}
round(mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
```
The mean flipper_length_mm is 200.92 with standard deviaition of 14.06

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
flipper_bill_plot =
  ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm,
                       y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)) + 
  geom_point() 
flipper_bill_plot 
ggsave("flipper_bill_plot.pdf")
```
